summary_1line: Duryodhana boasts of defeating the Pandavas despite Bhishma’s warnings, while Vidura responds with a long discourse on the virtues and power of self‑restraint.

image_candidates.scene_text: Duryodhana stands defiantly in the Kuru court before Bhishma, boasting that he, Karna, and Dussasana will slay the five Pandavas.
Vidura calmly addresses the royal court, teaching the virtues of self-restraint while the proud princes listen uneasily.
